Editor - central canvas runtime
|-- Source: packages/editor/src/lib/editor/Editor.ts

|-- store: reactive TLRecord store
|   |-- Document records: shapes, bindings, pages, assets
|   `-- Session records: camera, instance, page selection

|-- Runtime managers
|   |-- inputs: InputsManager - pointer and modifiers
|   |-- history: HistoryManager - undo and redo
|   |-- snaps: SnapManager - snapping
|   |-- _tickManager: TickManager - frame processing
|   |-- _spatialIndex: SpatialIndexManager - spatial queries
|   |-- edgeScrollManager: EdgeScrollManager
|   |-- focusManager: FocusManager
|   |-- overlays: OverlayManager - active overlays
|   |-- textMeasure: TextManager
|   `-- fonts: FontManager

|-- Registered implementations
|   |-- shapeUtils[type] - geometry, rendering, behavior
|   |-- bindingUtils[type] - shape relationships
|   |-- assetUtils[type] - asset behavior
|   `-- root: RootState - interaction state machine

|       |-- HandTool [tldraw/src/lib/tools/HandTool/]
|       |   |-- Idle / Pointing
|       |   |-- Dragging - delta / zoom -> setCamera(...)
|       |   `-- OneFingerZooming

|       |-- SelectTool [tldraw/src/lib/tools/SelectTool/]
|       |   |-- Idle / PointingCanvas / PointingShape
|       |   |-- Brushing / ScribbleBrushing
|       |   |-- Translating
|       |   |-- Resizing / Rotating
|       |   |-- EditingShape
|       |   `-- Handle and crop states
|       `-- Other registered tools

|-- Input entry point: dispatch(event)
|   `-- Queued / tick processing
|       |-- Update input state
|       |-- Handle shared camera interactions
|       `-- Route events to the tool state machine

|-- Camera API
|   |-- getCamera() / setCamera(...)
|   |-- zoomIn(...) / zoomOut(...) / zoomToFit(...)
|   |-- slideCamera(...)
|   |-- screenToPage(...) / pageToScreen(...)
|   `-- _setCamera(...)
|       |-- Constrain camera position and zoom
|       |-- Store camera with history: ignore
|       `-- Recompute pointer canvas coordinates

|-- Document and selection API
    |-- createShapes(...) / updateShapes(...) / deleteShapes(...)
    |-- select(...) / getSelectedShapeIds()
    |-- getShapeGeometry(...) / getShapePageTransform(...)
    `-- run(...) / undo() / redo()

`-- Snapshot helper integration (external functions)
    |-- Application calls getSnapshot(store) / loadSnapshot(...)
    `-- Helpers capture / restore Editor.store
